name: Medi_Track
description: Medical history tracking plugin for individual animals. Adds 'Abnormal' status checkbox, medical condition categorization with hierarchical taxonomy, document management per animal, and comprehensive medical log reporting. Integrates with ProgTrack status system and Master Track audit logging.
